In Network mode, only items matching the Insert Filter are sent to the network. An empty filter sends nothing to the network. Other items and remainders go to inventory. Items and components must match exactly.

In Network mode, items matching the Insert Filter are excluded from the network. An empty filter allows all items into the network. Excluded items and remainders go to inventory. Items and components must match exactly.
